G8-IQ-F1.constraint: An UNAVAILABLE outcome must never permit generation of replacement scientific material. It permits only recovery of the already-required evidence and continuation using the same study state.
G8-IQ-F1.ruling: A missing or unreadable durable producer registry or first-raw-marker artifact is classified as UNAVAILABLE, provided there is no evidence that the expected artifact's identity has changed. This is a recoverable infrastructure/evidence-availability condition, not by itself a scientific verification failure. After restoration, the artifact must still match the exact previously expected identity/digest/reference.

required_sealed_coverage: the completed-stage continuation case that was previously untested
G8-IQ-F2.ruling: Unexpected durable-log events receive the same classification regardless of chain shape. The existing W-04 semantics are authoritative. A genuinely unexpected/forbidden log event is FAILED_VERIFICATION, including when encountered after a completed-stage continuation. The completed-stage special case must not convert the same semantic defect into a retryable condition.

required_sealed_coverage: concurrency/boundary coverage proving that the protected authority state used for verification is the same state under which W and PASS are retained
G8-IQ-F3.ruling: Move issuance of W, retention of the W record, and recording of the PASS outcome inside the protected section, consistent with the Gate-8 scope text. The protected section must cover the complete verification-and-write transition so that another authority change cannot interleave between successful verification and durable recording of its result. Do not broaden the lock/protected section beyond what is necessary to satisfy that requirement.

admissibility_minimum: any existing receipt/attestation bindings already required by the adopted contract
G8-IQ-F4.admissibility_minimum_qualifier: verify the existing identities/bindings available under the frozen contract, as applicable
required_negative_tests: hand-constructed W without producer evidence cannot pass pre-U
W without its matching PASS outcome cannot pass
a mismatched PASS outcome cannot pass
W from the wrong producer root/attempt cannot pass
valid producer W + matching PASS can progress
G8-IQ-F4.ruling: Add an explicit operational W admissibility requirement. A hand-created W appended through the generic authority mechanism must not be sufficient to progress into the operational pre-U or U-issuance path. Both the pre-U template check and the dedicated U issuance path must require evidence that the W being consumed is the W produced by the authorized Gate-8 producer and that its corresponding retained outcome is PASS.
G8-IQ-F4.trust_model: Do not invent a new cryptographic trust model in seal 06. The fix prevents bypass through generic append under the existing evidence model. It does not claim protection against an attacker who has arbitrary write access and can forge every trusted on-disk artifact unless the frozen protocol already provides authentication against that threat.

G8-IQ-F5.disposition: RECORD ONLY; not fixed in seal 06
G8-IQ-F5.future: If a specific deterministic malformed-input exception is later identified that should semantically constitute verification failure, disposition that exact exception class/path separately rather than applying a broad catch-all rule.
G8-IQ-F5.ruling: An arbitrary exception must not automatically become FAILED_VERIFICATION; doing so could convert an implementation defect, parser bug or unexpected runtime fault into an irreversible scientific failure. Keep the existing interrupted/retry behavior for genuinely unclassified exceptions for this revision.
